shots.shot: Close-up on C-17 cargo stamp; ambient yard fades
Match cut to C-17 hand annotation on Berlin blueprint
Wide of archive; hand control to Konrad
Camera leaves the drawing through an archival window
Great Hall distant monumental silhouette, ordinary people foreground
Slow low-angle push and tilt up to the dome; a neighbour draws the curtains above the waiting family; held final frame (the parade and the return to the workbench follow)
Alexei files document; fade to Berlin tram bell
Konrad folds matching memorandum
Neutral-border schematic; no character control
Demo end and future-chapter promise
Konrad at the window of the German delegation's saloon car; night, snow plain, floodlit Line; a village under its steeple, a small station rushing past without a stop, a green signal
Match cut through the window frame: a level crossing's red lamps and floodlight
Alexei at the window of the Soviet car; tea glass in a metal holder; same plain from the other side; log-house village, a truss bridge over a frozen river
The Line before dawn from high above: the floodlit fence runs to the glowing Free City, Konrad's train on one side, Alexei's on the other, neither stopping
Dawn: both trains converge on the river bridge into Veltrava; crane up from the ice and the bank to the city rising over the bridge
Station clock at 9:40
Match cut to the palais clock at 9:40; control to Konrad
Night, platform 5: a special train with dark windows leaves without stopping
Two lit hotel windows across the station square, two silhouettes, one whistle
Station square at night: two hotels face each other across the snow; steam of the 23.40 train drifts off; radio interval signal
Alexei's room: Bakelite radio, tea glass, the Russian news
Match cut on the tuning dial to Konrad's room: the same radio, the German news; his pencil stops
Split: a folded note slides under each door; close-up of the note in two languages
Cafe Korridor after closing: chairs on the tables, Elena's table, an untouched glass; station clock 0.10
Two hotel doors open at once; two men in the snow, their tracks converge on the palais' dark east wing
The green lamp flickers over the sorting table; Konrad looks up
The stacks: an orange glow, the C-17 boxes catch; a figure in a porter's cap slips out, face never shown
The ramp door from inside: a shadow outside, the iron bolt slides home
Fire runs along the shelves, smoke rolls under the ceiling toward the camera; Alexei at the table
Inside the coal chute: dust, the file pushed up toward a square of snow light
The yard: the iron hatch flips open, Konrad crawls out with the file, smoke pours after him
Alexei's hand; Konrad pulls him out; the hatch slams; both in the snow, coughing
The east wing: souterrain windows burst orange, fire-brigade bells, snow through smoke
The quay bench: each man takes his half of the file (pages per the c3g choice)
They walk apart along the quay: Alexei east toward the station, Konrad west toward the palais
Wide: the burning wing mirrored in the river ice, the Line's searchlights, first grey of dawn
The station departures board, a fresh line: Tuesday 23.40, Kordon-17, platform 5
Veltrava station at first light: two trains on opposite platforms; Alexei boards the eastbound, Konrad the westbound, each with his half of the file under the coat
Split windows: Alexei's train crosses the snow plain toward the cooling towers of Karsk, Konrad's passes under the dome of the Great Hall
Karsk freight yard before dawn, the repaired signal shows green; Alexei walks to the lit cellar window of the freight office
Service tunnel 3: Alexei's lamp along the planks of a wagon; fresh red-brown paint, a stencil still taped on: C-17/45, a drip runs down; chalk beside it: Tuesday 23.40
Extreme close-up of the stencilled 45 (match cut)
Berlin at dawn: the same C-17/45 stencilled on crates at a loading hatch; a truck's tail lights; the stack goes down a shaft
The tram loop at the cleared block: the first tram of line 74 rings and stops; Konrad at the shelter; control to Konrad
Konrad lifts a card from the snow beside a split crate; his thumb along the perforated edge, No. 0417
Close-up of the perforation (match cut)
Karsk siding office: Alexei's fingers along the other perforated half, the same No. 0417; a kerosene lamp, stencils on the wall
Alexei looks up at the wagon outside the window; control to Alexei
Siding office: Alexei copies the card into his notebook; Lev slides the Russian half back into the box C-17/45 – accept
Close-up: the stamp ACCEPT in Cyrillic beside the box (match cut)
Berlin annex counter: the registrar's stamp comes down, DISPATCH, on another card
Konrad at the foot of the shaft ladder between the card cabinets, the German half in his coat; control to Konrad
Berlin morning: Konrad climbs out of the door in the advertising column, the Lindner file under his coat or empty-handed (per the c4d choice)
Marta's tram leaves the loop, Ilse at the last window; one ring of the bell, or two and Konrad raises his hand (per the c4d choice)
Karsk: Alexei and Lev climb out of the cellar into the dark yard under the green signal; Alexei's notebook with four numbers
The siding: wagon C-17/45 alone under a work lamp; the lamp goes out
Black; caption: Tuesday, 23.40, wagon C-17/45
